parameters.name: ForceStop
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to forcefully stop the instance. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false** (default)

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds stop-rc-instance --instance-id rc-m5sc1271fv344a1r0000 --force-stop false --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --stopped-mode KeepCharging --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds StopRCInstance --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'rc-m5sc1271fv344a1r0000' --StoppedMode KeepCharging --ForceStop false --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
